item.title: Punjab Govt Invites Baba Gurinder Singh Dhillon For The 350th Martyrdom Anniversary Of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib Ji
item.description: Punjab Education Minister Harjot Singh Bains and Advisor to Tourism and Cultural Affairs Department Mr. Deepak Bali extended an invitation to Baba Gurinder Singh Dhillon for the 350th Martyrdom Anniversary of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Sahib Ji, an official press release said.

item.title: Punjab Govt Extends Invitation to Giani Kuldeep Singh Garjgajj for 9th Guru Sahib Ji's 350th Martyrdom Anniversary Commemorations

item.title: From Farm to Campus: PAU Launches Outlet for Locally Processed Food
item.description: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has made an announcement for opening a dedicated on-campus outlet in the next two to three months. It is a move to make processed essentials affordable and accessible. The new retail point will offer locally processed staples – flour, pulses, edible oils and jaggery – to students, staff and the general public.

item.title: Punjab Brings All Registered Societies Under RTI: Cabinet Approves Major Transparency Reform
item.description: On Friday, the Punjab state cabinet approved the Societies Registration (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2025. This is an amendment to the old 1860 Societies Act; it mandates inclusion of all registered societies under the Right to Information Act, 2005 (RTI). The Punjab government has taken this initiative to bring transparency and accountability to the many non-profit, social-welfare, charitable and voluntary organisations operating in the state.

item.title: Golden Petals, Poetic Roots: Punjab Gul-e-Sahir Chrysanthemum Debuts at PAU
item.description: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana, blooms with a flower that carries both beauty and legacy: the chrysanthemum variety named Punjab Gul-e-Sahir. It is officially released in 2025; this vibrant mustard-yellow blossom is a heartfelt tribute to the lyrical heritage of poet Sahir Ludhianvi, with its name meaning “Flower of Sahir”.
